model_output: Apache NiFi is an open-source data integration tool designed to handle and process large volumes of data in real-time. It provides a simple, web-based interface for designing data flows, and supports a wide range of data sources and protocols. NiFi allows users to collect, process, and distribute data using a variety of techniques, including data filtering, transformation, and routing. It also supports powerful data processing capabilities, including data aggregation, data transformation, and data routing. NiFi is highly modular and can be easily extended with custom processors and controllers to support a wide range of use cases. It is used in a variety of industries, including healthcare, finance, and government.
